goal.minimumCoverage: At least 75% of 432 completed games (324 games)

features: Pre-week last-three score margin minus prior season-to-date margin
Abstention when predicted spread edge is small

search.range: Home adjustment -8 to +16; form coeff -1..1; opponent quality -0.7..0.7; scoring and defensive trend -0.7..0.7; rest -0.9..0.9; streak -2..2; edge-threshold 0..12

bestInSampleAcrossAllWeeks.warning: Retrospective winner chosen on whole dataset; 59.51% holdout is contaminated by its use for selection. Not a valid unseen prediction.

limitations: Only 2026 weeks 1-8, no multiple-season out-of-time validation
Historically fixed power ratings may contain in-season lookahead
Only games with suitable lines and site roster ratings; previous-game momentum reconstructed from graded games, omitting some other games
No coach matchup history, drive-level time leading, time of possession or unanswered-point sequence incorporated in this sweep
decision: Do not swap live model to this hindsight-optimized configuration; collect richer historical data and test on genuinely new weeks.
